harvestIndicators: Pinch flowers to extend leaf production
notes: Heat-loving annual. Downy mildew (BDM) is the big threat — DMR varieties (Prospera, Amazel) are alternatives.

seasonalTasks.title: Pinch off basil flower buds
seasonalTasks.body: Pinch stem tips for a bushier plant, and pinch off flower buds as soon as you see them. Left on, buds change the flavor of the leaves.
